The resurgent Griffonian Empire grows like a tumour over the continent, driven by the urge to relive the bygone days of the old empire. As its soldiers storm its surrounding countries to restore glory which never truly existed, it's becoming clearer and clearer that, unless stopped, they will soon come knocking on Vedina's door. We must cut out this cancer before it spreads, and strike before they become unstoppable. We will avenge our forefathers and do today what they couldn't so many years ago. We will end the scourge of the Griffonian Empire for good.
